briefdescription.para: This function checks the JTAG device state change.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks the DAP security-gate state change.

para.verbatim: When Secure gate is opened from close state this API raises an error, if the gate is closed and re-opened again this function recognizes the state change and performs the action configured.

parameterdescription.para: is of pointer of void type.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success and error code on failure

para.verbatim: When Secure gate is opened from close state this API raises an error, if the gate is closed and re-opened again this function recognizes the state change and performs the action configured. Versal_2VP_P has no JTAG_STATUS_0; open is DAP_SECURITY == 0xFFFFFFFF, the same value XLoader_EnableJtag writes (including PLM_AUTH_JTAG unlock). On HWRoT boot the first CLOSE-to-OPEN edge raises SW error 0x8E (XIL_EVENT_ERROR_MASK_DEV_STATE_CHANGE). Default EAM action is XPLMI_EM_ACTION_NONE; EM_SET_ACTION can escalate it.

parameterdescription.para: is of pointer of void type.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on success and error code on failure

para.heading: Procedure to link and compile the example for the default ddr less designs

detaileddescription.para: The default linker settings places a software stack, heap and data in DDR memory. For this example to work, any data shared between client running on A72/R5/PL and server running on PMC, should be placed in area which is accessible to both client and server.
To keep things simple, by default the cache is disabled for this example
To build this application, xilmailbox library must be included in BSP and xilloader library must be in client mode and xilsecure must be in client mode
This example is supported for Versal Net and Versal 2Ve 2Vm devices.

para.preformatted: Ver Who Date Changes ----- ---- -------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 1.00 har 12/11/23 Initial release kpt 10/04/24 Added support to validate authentication enabled partial PDI 2.40 sri 03/26/26 Included common client header file for cache disable option 2.50 sri 09/18/26 Added PDI_SRC_SIZE_IN_BYTES macro for the user to input the size of the PDI downloaded into DDR and used it as the D-cache invalidate length instead of sizeof of the address variable

listitem.para: Update the example defines below for the PDI that will be downloaded into DDR: PDI_SRC_ADDR - Address in DDR where the authenticated PDI is placed PDI_SRC_SIZE_IN_BYTES - Size in bytes of the PDI to be downloaded to run this example. It is used as the D-cache invalidate length when cache is enabled, so it must cover the complete PDI downloaded into DDR PDI_TYPE - XLOADER_PDI_TYPE_FULL for full PDI or XLOADER_PDI_TYPE_PARTIAL for partial PDI
Download the authenticated PDI of PDI_SRC_SIZE_IN_BYTES bytes into DDR at PDI_SRC_ADDR (for example, xsdb: dow -data -force pdi.bin PDI_SRC_ADDR).
Select the target, download this example ELF and run it.
